long_biography.plain_text:
At EE Ranches, Jo Ellard has remained a hands-on breeder rather than a distant proprietor. She selects stallions, plans matings and decides which young horses enter training or sale programmes. A decade directing the National Cutting Horse Association’s youth committee preceded service on its executive committee and a term as president.

Years of attending Fort Worth horse shows also shaped Bowie House. Ellard bought property in the city’s Cultural District, developed a luxury hotel and selected Auberge Resorts Collection to manage it. She worked with the design team and turned an art collection built over two decades into a gallery distributed through guest rooms and shared spaces. The gallery hosts walks and artist talks for hotel guests and local visitors.
